title: Document recursive agent growth loop and concise entrypoint
goal: Persist the complete five-step autonomous growth loop while keeping the default agent entrypoint short and linking to detailed operating guidance.
context: PersonalAgent-iOS already defines task contracts and a P0 Alpha gate. Agents need a durable detailed specification for observe, orient, plan, execute, verify/learn and context recovery, without forcing every task to load the full document.
forbidden_changes: Do not change runtime behavior, security policy, or execution permissions.
Do not duplicate a backlog or replace Issue #347 as the P0 source of truth.
Do not claim CI, merge, or physical-device verification without evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Detailed documentation describes the five-step loop and context recovery rules.
The agent entrypoint remains concise and links to the detailed document.
A task contract records scope, acceptance criteria, verification, dependencies, and recovery.
The documentation and task contract are reviewed in the pull request and relevant checks pass.
verification: Review the diff for scope, concise entrypoint, and accurate claims.
dependencies: Issue #347 remains the P0 product priority; this documentation task does not supersede it.
recovery: If validation or scope review fails, correct the contract or split the documentation change without broadening runtime scope; keep status in_progress until the required evidence exists.
